hero.name: Matthias Kallenbach
hero.role: Senior Full-Stack Web Developer · IoT Enthusiast · Local AI & Generative UI
hero.intro1: Node.js-focused full-stack developer with 20+ years of experience building complex web applications. I love the frontend, I build things that run anywhere: from small computers to large-scale cloud-native setups. And I'm deep into local AI.
hero.intro2: I'm exploring generative UI — interfaces that compose and adapt themselves around the task instead of a fixed set of screens. And I care about sovereign, on-prem AI: running models on your own hardware, keeping your data, your stack and your autonomy in your own hands.
